question: Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence. He insisted** to go** home.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**insisted**" is typically followed by the preposition "**on**" when indicating a persistent demand or decision.
 
• The phrase "**insisted to go**" is grammatically incorrect because "**to go**" does not align with the preposition "**on**" used with "insisted."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**insisted on going**," ensuring proper grammatical structure and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is corrected by selecting "**on going**" as the appropriate option.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He insisted on going home."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "going on" **– This option is incorrect as it does not fit the sentence contextually or grammatically.
 
• **Option 2: "upon going" **– This option is incorrect as "upon going" suggests a different meaning and does not align with "insisted."
 
• **Option 3: "that he goes" **– This option is incorrect because "insisted" does not pair well with "that he goes" in this context.
